name: Toby
self_text: Hi! I'm Toby, a non-binary Vietnamese person in my mid 20s. When I'm not with my Leica, I spend a lot of my free time birdwatching because I love the peace of nature. Honestly, I'm just looking for a practice session working on specific shots. I tend to go at a moderate pace, as that's how I enjoy it. Regarding the technical side of things, I'm happy to teach post-processing for the editing. I'm also cool with not taking portraits of each other during our time together. In terms of scheduling, most weeks I can do Saturday morning or Sunday morning.

requests.request_text: I need you to be okay with a slow pace or a moderate pace, and you have to be available Sunday morning or Saturday morning. It's a deal-breaker unless you are okay with taking portraits of each other. It would be nice if you are into a practice session working on specific shots or a structured instruction session. A small bonus if you are the one who learns post-processing from me.
